stories.title: Clogau poppy pins on sale at Broughton store to raise money for Army Benevolent Fund
stories.summary: Limited-edition poppy pins raising money for the Army Benevolent Fund are going on sale at Clogau’s Broughton store ahead of Remembrance Sunday. The Bodelwyddan-based jewellery company, known for using Welsh gold, has produced 10,000 pins for 2026, the third year of the campaign. stories.summary: Golftyn Lane in Connah’s Quay is among the roads closed in Flintshire this week, with more than 25 sets of roadworks listed across the county. stories.title: North Wales Everton fans changing at Bidston face packed trains after games
stories.summary: Everton fans travelling home to north Wales through Bidston are among those caught up in crowded trains after evening and Sunday matches, according to a supporter calling for more frequent services. Season ticket holder Alan Runswick wants Merseyrail to run Wirral Line trains every 15 minutes after all Everton games, instead of every 30 minutes.

stories.title: Deeside bike shop beats six UK rivals to Independent Bike Dealer of the Year
stories.summary: A Queensferry bike shop has been named the UK’s Independent Bike Dealer of the Year. The Cycle Hub, on Interlinq Trade Park, won the award at the BikeBiz Awards ceremony in Birmingham on 15 October.
